source: AWS IAM GetRoleTemplateVersion; template ARNs from the IAM User Guide role template directory

templates.Description: Creates a role that grants PowerUser permissions to the calling AWS service, allowing it to create and manage most AWS resources on your behalf. Intended for services that require wide-ranging permissions. The trusted service is configurable via the AWSServiceName parameter.

ParametersDefinition.Name: AWSServiceName
ParametersDefinition.Description: Service principal of the service

ParametersDefinition.Name: RoleName
ParametersDefinition.Description: Customized name for the role

templates.Description: Create a role that grants AWS Backup the permissions it needs to protect your resources, including creating and managing backups for DynamoDB, RDS, EC2 EBS volumes, EFS file systems, and Storage Gateway volumes. This is the standard service role used by AWS Backup when performing backup and restore jobs.
templates.RoleDescriptionPattern: Standard service role the provides AWS Backup service permission to create and restore backups on your behalf across AWS services

ParametersDefinition.Name: accountId
ParametersDefinition.Description: Account id of the target account

ParametersDefinition.Name: RoleName
ParametersDefinition.Description: Custom name for the role

templates.Description: Creates a role that provides full administrative control over the Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio domain, and broad permissions to your account's data and AWS services to execute operations within Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio.
templates.RoleDescriptionPattern: Administrative role that provides full administrative control over the Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio domain, and broad permissions to your account's data and AWS services to execute operations within Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio.

ParametersDefinition.Name: CMK_ENABLED
ParametersDefinition.Description: An indicator on whether a custom KMS key is used. Must be True or False

ParametersDefinition.Name: RoleName
ParametersDefinition.Description: Custom name for the role

ParametersDefinition.Name: accountId
ParametersDefinition.Description: Account id of the target account

ParametersDefinition.Name: keyAccountId
ParametersDefinition.Description: AWS account that hosts the KMS key. Effective only if CMK_ENABLED is True.

ParametersDefinition.Name: keyRegion
ParametersDefinition.Description: AWS region for the KMS key. Effective only if CMK_ENABLED is True.

ParametersDefinition.Name: kmsKeyId
ParametersDefinition.Description: KMS key id for the custom key. Effective only if CMK_ENABLED is True.

templates.Description: User role that provides broad permissions to your account's data and AWS services to execute operations within Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio.
templates.RoleDescriptionPattern: User role that provides broad permissions to your account's data and AWS services to execute operations within Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio.

ParametersDefinition.Name: RoleName
ParametersDefinition.Description: Custom name for the role

ParametersDefinition.Name: accountId
ParametersDefinition.Description: Account id of the target account

templates.Description: Creates a role that allows AWS Secrets Manager to perform secret rotation by accessing and updating secret values
templates.RoleDescriptionPattern: Allows AWS Secrets Manager to perform secret rotation by accessing and updating secret values

ParametersDefinition.Name: ADMIN_RESOURCE_ENABLED
ParametersDefinition.Description: An indicator on whether a administrative resource type for secrets manager is enabled. Must be True or False

ParametersDefinition.Name: CMK_ENABLED
ParametersDefinition.Description: An indicator on whether a custom key is used with the secret. Must be True or False

ParametersDefinition.Name: RoleName
ParametersDefinition.Description: Custom name for the role

ParametersDefinition.Name: accountId
ParametersDefinition.Description: Account id of the target account

ParametersDefinition.Name: adminType
ParametersDefinition.Description: Administrative resource type for secret rotation access condition. Effective only if ADMIN_RESOURCE_ENABLED is True

ParametersDefinition.Name: kmsKeyArn
ParametersDefinition.Description: List of KMS key ARNs for the custom keys. Effective only if CMK_ENABLED is True.

ParametersDefinition.Name: region
ParametersDefinition.Description: AWS region for the Secret Manager secret

ParametersDefinition.Name: resourceType
ParametersDefinition.Description: Partner/resource type for secret rotation access condition
